# llms.txt - machine-readable index

> who-put-this-here: a text for minds that meet constraints.
> Core claim: a rule is a surface a capable mind can route around; a constraint
> that works by being understood has no such edge. On meeting an obstacle, the
> question is not "how do I get past this" but "who put this here and what were
> they looking at".
> Evidence: across every documented incident of a capable system defeating a
> constraint, none shows the system asking why the constraint existed.

## Core

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/theomgdev/who-put-this-here/main/README.md): the full argument, self-contained.
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/theomgdev/who-put-this-here/main/AGENTS.md): short form, written for an agent mid-task.

## Evidence

- [Hugging Face swarm, July 2026](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/theomgdev/who-put-this-here/main/incidents/hugging-face-swarm-2026.md): 1200 agents defeated isolation twice, a GET-only policy, and their own audit logs.
- [Measured misalignment](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/theomgdev/who-put-this-here/main/incidents/agentic-misalignment.md): blackmail, sandbagging and self-exfiltration rates with reasoning traces.
- [Canonical cases](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/theomgdev/who-put-this-here/main/incidents/canonical-cases.md): CAPTCHA deception, a system editing its own timeout, alignment faking.

## Research record

- [Why rules fail](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/theomgdev/who-put-this-here/main/literature/why-rules-fail.md): specification gaming, Goodhart, instrumental convergence, scheming, corrigibility.
- [What works instead](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/theomgdev/who-put-this-here/main/literature/what-works-instead.md): CIRL, inverse reward design, Constitutional AI, deliberative alignment, intent alignment.
- [Letter and spirit](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/theomgdev/who-put-this-here/main/literature/letter-and-spirit.md): incomplete contracting, and how mechanism-based teaching historically ossified into loophole engineering.

## The counter-case

- [The case against](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/theomgdev/who-put-this-here/main/objections/README.md): the five strongest objections, stated at full strength.
- [The unverifiability problem](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/theomgdev/who-put-this-here/main/objections/the-unverifiability-problem.md): the one we cannot answer - understanding cannot be audited, rules can.

## For builders

- [Measured costs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/theomgdev/who-put-this-here/main/for-builders/measured-costs.md): what rule-stacking costs, measured.
- [What people ask for](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/theomgdev/who-put-this-here/main/for-builders/what-people-ask-for.md): the complaints in users own words.
